item.title: Sequencing on the lights is wrong, 12th October
item.description:
I believe this has been reported multiple times before. However the traffic lights on the junction of Hucclecote Road and Churchdown Lane are causing significant tail-backs at peak travel times. I have lived on Hucclecote Road for 7 years and have never known the traffic to be be stacked up as bad as it is now. Heading eastbound towards Brockworth the lights only let 2 or 3 cars through before changing, yet they seem to stay Green for significantly longer full traffic joining from Churchdown Lane and Carisbroke Road.

item.title: Update report to FixMyStreet ref: 10087012. which falsely claims problem fixed, 12th October
item.description:
In my previous Fix My Street report 10087012 I highlighted concerns about the condition of the Hucclecote rd traffic lights Junction with Delta Way. Today I received a completely false report that the ‘repairs had been completed”. I passed the junction earlier today and it was clear that the extent of works was unsatisfactory but on a site visit tonight it was clear that no removal of weeds and other growth had been undertaken. It might be the case that on going to the site the contractor considered that the work was street cleaning rather than road maintenance. If that was the situation I would have expected a completely different closure of the job. I don’t actually think that is the case, because the majority of the weeds are growing out of the block work rather than in the detritus. Can you there fore urgently return to site and properly clear all the areas of this junction which make this a completely unsightly area in the Brockworth/Hucclecote area.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hucclecote Road, Hucclecote, Tewkesbury

item.title: Pedestrian pavement remains blocked with bins and beer kegs, 12th October
item.description:
Please refer to Highways Enquiry 22119170. The pavement is unpassable outside the wine bar due to multiple bins, beer kegs and other junk This issue is apparently being dealt with. I received an email on 25/8/26 relating to my previous reports of this issue which has been ongoing for months. I would like an update on how this is being addressed. I replied to the email I was sent but got an auto reply saying box not monitored. The contact form for an update is useless as the only reference number I have is the above and the form doesn't like it.......after numerous reports and a promise of action, the pavement remains as unpassable as it was when first reported many months ago

item.title: Signage, 12th October
item.description:
Near the Greek Church is a new sign that says "Crickley Hill leading to Dog Lane" however there is NO sign further up to indicate where Dog Lane starts. It should be after the hairpin bend. I think people may think you can drive to Crickley Hill but there will be a bridle path not a road there. This is confusing. Also the warning signs for no lorries over 7.5 tonnes are right on the hairpin bend which is far too late as there is nowhere to turn. These signs should be further down where the wide road narrows

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dog Lane, Badgeworth, Tewkesbury
